description: For distinct propositional atoms p and q, the formulas p implies q and q have no natural-deduction derivation of p.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.affirmingConsequent_not_derivable.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α)
  (hab : a ≠ b) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives
      {(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a).impl (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b}
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a)
